why: The three famous names (TechRadar x2, Tom's Guide) are all off-target: a Mac mini deal post, a mini PC roundup, and a monitor guide. The only on-topic pages are Satechi's own compatibility list and store pages (one of which contradicts itself by saying 1 Gbps), empty or thin Best Buy listings, and a duplicated AI-written blog that analysed macOS driver tables but admits it owns no adapter and measured nothing. No reviewer or authority tests whether any adapter actually delivers 2.5 Gbps on an M4 Mac mini, so a page comparing several adapters by chipset, driverless macOS support, measured NAS throughput and price would stand out.
